$comment: Third-party skills installed alongside frontend-system-design via THEIR OWN official installers. Commands verified against each project's README. Installer packages are pinned to exact versions (scripts/validate-skills.js enforces this); bump them deliberately after reviewing the upstream changes. `skills add <owner/repo>` still fetches that repo's default branch. {agent}/{providers}/{skills_agents}/{scope}/{global} placeholders are filled by src/cli/companions.js. Nothing from these projects is vendored into this repo.

companions.name: UI UX Pro Max
companions.purpose: Searchable database of UI styles, color palettes, font pairings and UX guidelines across many stacks

companions.name: Impeccable
companions.purpose: Design polish, critique and audit commands plus anti-pattern detection for frontend UI
companions.note: May ask whether to set up its design hook; answer in the terminal.

companions.name: Vercel agent-skills (react-best-practices, web-design-guidelines, composition-patterns)
companions.purpose: React/Next.js performance rules, UI guideline reviews and component composition patterns
companions.command: npx --yes skills@1.7.6 add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill react-best-practices web-design-guidelines composition-patterns --agent {skills_agents}{skills_global} --yes

companions.name: Anthropic frontend-design
companions.purpose: Distinctive, intentional visual direction for new UI; avoids generic templated aesthetics
